Creators must be at least 18 years old and complete government ID verification before publishing any content, regardless of monetization status.
Do I need to verify my ID even if I'm not planning to charge for content yet?
According to the platform's policy, yes — ID verification is required before publishing any content at all, independent of whether you're monetizing yet.
